map.：Bessman 分类法：先按 MCV 分小细胞性(<80)、正细胞性(80–1: : Bessman classification: first classify by MCV into microcytic (<80), normocytic (80-100) and macrocytic (>100); then by RDW (reference <=15%) into homogeneous/heterogeneous, giving 6 combinations: microcytic heterogeneous (typical iron deficiency), microcytic homogeneous (thalassemia/chronic disease), normocytic heterogeneous (early iron deficiency or mixed), normocytic homogeneous (acute blood loss/renal anemia), macrocytic heterogeneous (megaloblastic), macrocytic homogeneous (alcohol/liver disease/drugs).

map.MCV/RDW 能区分缺铁和地贫吗？: Can MCV/RDW distinguish iron deficiency from thalassemia?
map.有提示价值：缺铁多为小细胞+RDW 升高（不均一），典型地贫多为小细胞+RDW: It has suggestive value: iron deficiency is usually microcytic with raised RDW (heterogeneous), while typical thalassemia is usually microcytic with normal RDW (homogeneous). But overlap is common, and confirmation relies on serum iron/ferritin and hemoglobin electrophoresis or genetic testing.
map.RDW 参考值为什么是 ≤15%？: Why is the RDW reference value <=15%?
map.RDW 反映红细胞体积变异系数，多数实验室参考上限约 14–15%；不同仪器/人: RDW reflects the coefficient of variation of red cell volume; most laboratories set the upper reference limit at about 14-15%; instruments and populations differ slightly, so interpretation should follow your own laboratory reference interval.
